meta.source: Daybook design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/VHiRsqmVbKtnzEJyDhr9SE) and PRD.md, Oct 20, 2026

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the note editor, inputs and sheets.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar, segmented-control track, quiet chips, kbd hints and the auth side panel.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines on cards, dividers and list rows. Decorative only: never the only edge of a form control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Text-input and form-control borders; at least 3:1 against surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg, surface and sidebar.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Nav items and secondary body text on bg, surface and sidebar.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, meta text and timestamps; at least 5:1 on bg, surface and sidebar.

tokens.name: ink-done
tokens.usage: Completed task titles, always paired with line-through.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button and capture button fill. One primary action per view.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Links, text buttons, checkbox fill and focus. Text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline with a 2px offset.

tokens.name: lavender-bg
tokens.usage: Project pastel 1: chips, cards and time blocks of the project that owns it.

tokens.name: lavender-ink
tokens.usage: Text on lavender-bg (7.3:1 light).

tokens.name: lavender-dot
tokens.usage: Lavender project dot, progress fill and today's column border. Never text.

tokens.name: mint-bg
tokens.usage: Project pastel 2.

tokens.name: mint-ink
tokens.usage: Text on mint-bg (5.8:1 light); also success text on surface.

tokens.name: mint-dot
tokens.usage: Mint project dot and the daily progress bar.

tokens.name: peach-bg
tokens.usage: Project pastel 3.

tokens.name: peach-ink
tokens.usage: Text on peach-bg (5.7:1 light).

tokens.name: peach-dot
tokens.usage: Peach project dot.

tokens.name: rose-bg
tokens.usage: Project pastel 4; also error alert background.

tokens.name: rose-ink
tokens.usage: Text on rose-bg (6.5:1 light); error text.

tokens.name: rose-dot
tokens.usage: Rose project dot and the schedule's now line.

tokens.name: sky-bg
tokens.usage: Project pastel 5; calendar events and the weekly review card.

tokens.name: sky-ink
tokens.usage: Text on sky-bg (5.9:1 light).

tokens.name: sky-dot
tokens.usage: Sky project dot.

tokens.name: butter-bg
tokens.usage: Reserved for notices (carry-over banner, pinned decision) and Daily notes.

tokens.name: butter-ink
tokens.usage: Text on butter-bg (5.9:1 light).

tokens.name: butter-dot
tokens.usage: Daily note dot.

tokens.name: inbox-bg
tokens.usage: Chip for tasks with no project (Inbox).

tokens.name: inbox-ink
tokens.usage: Text on inbox-bg.

tokens.name: notice-bg
tokens.usage: Carry-over banner and other non-error notices.

tokens.name: notice-ink
tokens.usage: Text on notice-bg.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Error alert background (sign-in failures, sync problems).

tokens.name: error-ink
tokens.usage: Error text on error-bg or surface.

tokens.name: error-border
tokens.usage: 1.5px border on a field in error.

tokens.name: now-line
tokens.usage: The current-time line in the schedule.

tokens.name: progress
tokens.usage: Fill of the Today progress bar.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Today's date, the week range, a project name.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: Mobile titles and auth headings (32px on desktop auth).

styles.name: task
styles.usage: Top 3 task titles and form inputs.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Protecting the morning for the wireframe.
styles.usage: Default UI text, task rows, buttons (at 600).

styles.name: note-body
styles.usage: Text inside the note editor, max 680px wide.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Counts, dates, secondary links. Usually ink-muted.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and chips. Always text-transform: uppercase for eyebrows; chips stay sentence case.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside segmented controls and between nav items.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and small inline items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between a checkbox and its label; list row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (side), minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a column; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between the two main columns of Today.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top padding of a desktop view.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Maximum side gutter of a desktop view.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keyboard hints (kbd).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small cards, week-board cards, color dots use 4px.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, schedule blocks.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, the capture bar, banners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large section cards (Schedule, Daily note).

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Project header band.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of the mobile bottom sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, filter chips, progress bars.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Active nav item and selected segmented tab.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Capture bar and auth cards only.

tokens.name: shadow-fab
tokens.usage: Mobile capture button.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Text inputs and auth provider buttons.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The main call to action on a form or sheet.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar basis; it stacks above content below 820px.

tokens.name: note-measure
tokens.usage: Max width of note text.
